name: Append leads from a webhook to a Google Sheets row

parameters.content:
## Append leads from a webhook to a Google Sheets row

## Who's it for

Anyone who wants incoming leads in a spreadsheet immediately, without paying for a form product that does it for them.

## How it works

A webhook receives the submission. A Set node maps the incoming payload to the columns you want, which keeps all the field mapping in one place - when the payload changes shape later, that Set node is the only thing you edit. The Google Sheets node then appends a row. Append is used rather than update, so existing rows are never overwritten and the sheet stays a clean append-only log.

## How to set up

1. Create a Google Sheets credential in n8n.
2. Create a sheet and add a header row matching the fields you want to capture.
3. Select that document and sheet in the **Append row to sheet** node.
4. Adjust the Set node to the field names your source actually sends.
5. Copy the webhook production URL into your form or ad platform.

## Requirements

A Google account and a Google Sheets credential in n8n. Both are free.

## How to customize

Add a Remove Duplicates node after the Set node to keep repeat submissions out of the sheet. Add an IF node before the append to route bad or test submissions somewhere else, or a Slack node after it to be notified on every new lead.

### 1. Receive the lead
Point your form, ad platform, or landing page at the production URL of this node.

### 2. Map fields in one place
All the fields you care about are set here, in one node. When the incoming payload changes shape, this is the only node you edit - the sheet node keeps working unchanged.

### 3. Append, never overwrite
The operation is **append**, so each lead becomes a new row and nothing already in the sheet is touched.
